messages:
Nadia: Heads-up: planning a short weekend experiment to move $8k from low-velocity generic search into retargeting + countdown creatives for the webinar. Aim: CPL <= $40 and at least 25% increase in registrations MoM.
Carlos: Explain the countdown creatives - dynamic timer on ad or on landing?
Nadia: Both. Ad uses dynamic countdown overlay (12-72h window) and landing page shows matching timer. Creative set: Countdown-A (short), Countdown-B (with testimonial). Rotate by device.
Maya: Audience? frequency? also we need to route webinar leads to sales fast — HubSpot mapping?
Nadia: Retarget 14/30-day site visitors + ad engagers. Frequency cap 3/day. Desktop gets countdown with testimonial; mobile gets countdown without video. HubSpot owner routing: demo requests -> enterprise queue; webinar signups -> SDR queue. SLA: SDR to attempt outreach <30m.
AdsBot: Meta Ads payload (apply to rdw-retarget and rdw-webinar-lookalike):
```
POST /marketing_api/v2/campaigns/{campaign_id}/ads
{ "daily_spend": 8000, "bid_type": "target_cpa", "target_cpa": 40, "audience_expansion": 0.25 }
```
Also set creative rotation schedule and mobile optimization flag.
Ben: Landing page updated: /webinar-cta-countdown (lightweight + event pixel wired). I added hidden field source_platform=meta and creative_slot. A/B urls ready.
Jules: UTMs please standardize: utm_source=meta, utm_medium=paid-social, utm_campaign=webinar_apr_countdown_v1, utm_content=creative_slot. I'll add creative_id for analytics.
Maya: LeadRouterBot, can you confirm webhook for HubSpot and fallback to inbox if mapping fails?
LeadRouterBot: Confirmed. Webhook snippet:
```
POST https://hooks.redwood.dev/leadrouter
Headers: { "X-API-Key": "***" }
Body: { "email": "{{lead.email}}", "campaign": "webinar_apr_countdown_v1", "type": "{{lead.type}}" }
```
On failure -> retry 3x, then write to leads-inbox@redwood.com. Routing rules: type==demo -> enterprise_queue; type==webinar -> sdr_queue. SLA tags attached.
Carlos: How are we measuring immediate CPL? want a fast proxy in Looker for registrations/ad_clicks.
Jules: I'll add 'instant_cpl' to the dashboard (ad_spend / registrations_last_1h). Also add mobile vs desktop split.
Nadia: Budget split: 60% core retarget, 40% lookalike. If instant_cpl < $30 for 3 consecutive hours, auto-add $2k from search budget. If instant_cpl > $70 for 2 consecutive hours, pause lookalike.
Ben: I added GTM event webinar_registed and funnel steps. Also set a mobile fallback page that removes the video to reduce load.
Maya: We'll need a short playbook for SDRs: verify registrant, mark lead_type, book follow-up if demo requested. I'll drop a doc in Confluence.
AdsBot: Note: account daily cap = $20k. Current baseline spend = $14k. Weekend shift should be within caps but monitor.
LeadRouterBot: Scheduled health checks: 2026-04-03 08:00 PT (launch), 2026-04-03 13:00 PT, 2026-04-03 19:00 PT. Auto-alert to #marketing if webhook error rate > 2%.
Jules: Creative guidance: three-second mute play for mobile (no autoplay sound), CTA text: 'Save my seat' vs 'Request demo' A/B.
Carlos: Who's publishing the ad set at 6am PT Friday? I can do it and watch pacing for first 3 hours.
Nadia: @Carlos please take. @Maya monitor HubSpot routing and SLA tags. @Jules watch instant_cpl and mobile CTR. If CTR drops by > 30% swap Countdown-B -> Countdown-C (UGC clip).
Carlos: On it. Will post a quick status update here after the 1st hour.
Nadia: Thanks all. Keep messages concise during the burst. :rocket:
